title: Cloud Bread
description: These light and fluffy 3-ingredient cloud breads are a gluten-free alternative to bread that are quick and easy to make and paleo-friendly.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Place cream cheese in a microwave-safe bowl and warm in the microwave at 10-second intervals until softened, about 30 seconds. Cool to room temperature, about 5 minutes. Mix in egg yolks until smooth.
Place egg whites and baking powder in a glass, metal, or ceramic bowl; beat together until stiff peaks form.
Fold yolk mixture gently into egg whites until batter is just combined and light yellow in color.
Scoop batter into 4-inch rounds on baking sheet, flattening peaks with the back of the spoon.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 17 to 20 minutes.

video.description: You’re only 3 ingredients away from heavenly light cloud bread! Simply mix eggs with a little cream cheese for body and richness and a touch of baking powder for a bit of rise and you’ve got all the necessary elements. Beat the egg whites, fold into yolks, spoon out portions and bake. Seriously—that’s it! Now load each slice up with your favorite toppings and eat.
